method: Original SVG variations, rendered with Chromium.

concepts.name: Soft Workbench
concepts.idea: The familiar bench, a little warmer.
concepts.description: Keeps the original silhouette and floating project block. Small corner radii soften the sturdy pixel construction.

concepts.name: Piece in Place
concepts.idea: One piece away from making it yours.
concepts.description: An offset block lines up with a recess in the worktop. The bench becomes a little project being assembled.

concepts.name: Soft Joint
concepts.description: The original interlocking rhythm with rounded outer corners and softened notches. Closest to the rounded reference marks.

concepts.name: Close Fit
concepts.description: Two complementary pieces form a compact square. A stepped seam keeps the join visible in a single colour.

concepts.name: Joined Workbench
concepts.idea: A bench built from two parts.
concepts.description: Combines the workbench silhouette with a stepped joint. The seam makes collaboration part of the structure itself.
